import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    diff = [0] * (n + 2)  # diff[i]: change in the number of adults still giving stones when alien i comes of age
    givers = 0
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        givers += diff[i]
        stones = int(data[1 + i]) + givers
        gives = min(stones, n - 1 - i)  # one stone to each later alien, while stones last
        diff[i + 1] += 1
        diff[i + 1 + gives] -= 1
        out.append(stones - gives)
    print(" ".join(map(str, out)))


main()
